question: How do I track my UrbanThreads order?
answer: As soon as your package is dispatched, we send a tracking link via SMS and email. You can also visit https://urbanthreads.example.com/track and enter your Order ID and phone number to see live courier milestones.

question: Do you ship internationally outside India?
answer: Currently, UrbanThreads only ships within India across 25,000+ pin codes. International shipping to the US, UK, and UAE will be launching soon in late 2026.

question: How do I care for and wash heavyweight cotton hoodies?
answer: Machine wash cold inside-out with like colors using mild detergent. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low or line dry in the shade to preserve garment shape, texture, and custom graphics. Iron on low heat avoiding direct contact with prints and embroidery.

question: Can I cancel or modify an order after placing it?
answer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 2 hours of placement before warehouse fulfillment begins. Please email support@urbanthreads.example.com or call +91-9876543210 immediately with your Order ID.

question: Are Cash on Delivery (COD) orders eligible for refunds?
answer: Yes! When returning a COD order, our system sends a secure payout link to your registered phone number allowing you to receive instant funds via UPI or direct bank account transfer.
